The '''Abhean Shipyards''' were stationed at the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]]. They constructed the [[Chu'unthor|''Sunburris'']] which was sponsored by [[Jedi ace]] [[Crix Sunburris]]. It was later renamed the ''Chu'unthor'' and crashed on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="Jedi Path" /> At one point, Abhean Shipyards' [[chief designer]] and [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] was [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Felmas]]. During the age of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the shipyards built and maintained container vessels almost exclusively for the [[Imperial Supply Corps]].<ref name="FaDCR" />
